---
title: Pitfalls — Image as ndarray
---

## BGR vs. RGB

OpenCV defaults to BGR ordering. If you use `cv2.imread`, convert to RGB before further processing: `cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)`.

## uint8 vs. float32

Many OpenCV functions expect `uint8` [0–255]. If you convert to `float32` for calculations, remember to scale back to `uint8` before saving or displaying.

## Normalization pitfalls

Dividing by 255.0 yields floats in [0,1]. Do not mix normalized and unnormalized arrays without explicit conversion.
